definitions.explanation: the moon when it appears as a semicircle, either first quarter or last quarter
a period of approximately two weeks or 15 days

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{半月|はんげつ}だ。
{半月|はんげつ}が{雲|くも}の{間|あいだ}から{見|み}えた。
examples.english: The half moon was visible between the clouds.

examples.japanese: {半月|はんげつ}で{十|じゅう}キロ{痩|や}せた。
examples.english: I lost 10 kilograms in half a month.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}まで{半月|はんげつ}{切|き}った。
examples.english: There's less than half a month until the trip.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{準備|じゅんび}に{半月|はんげつ}かかった。
examples.english: It took half a month to prepare for the move.

examples.japanese: {半月板|はんげつばん}を{怪我|けが}した。

notes:
COMPOUND:
{半|はん} (half) + {月|げつ} (moon, month)

MOON PHASES:
- {新月|しんげつ} - new moon
- {三日月|みかづき} - crescent moon
- {半月|はんげつ} - half moon
- {満月|まんげつ} - full moon
- {上弦|じょうげん}の{月|つき} - first quarter moon
- {下弦|かげん}の{月|つき} - last quarter moon

ANATOMY:
- {半月板|はんげつばん} - meniscus (knee cartilage, named for its half-moon shape)

CONTRAST:
- {半月|はんげつ} (two weeks) vs {一ヶ月|いっかげつ} (one month)
